Debug.Name: Debug logging
Debug.Hint: Write Ammo Tracker diagnostics to the browser console (F12).

GinzzzuAmmoFix.Name: Fix double ammo use with Ginzzzu's CoC7 Sheets
GinzzzuAmmoFix.Hint: Ginzzzu's sheet removes rounds a second time on multi-shot and full-auto attacks (6 rounds, 3 shots: empty). This switches off its extra ammo bookkeeping; CoC7 still spends the rounds you fire. Turn off only if Ginzzzu fixes this upstream.
